description: Read BEFORE creating any chart, graph, plot, dashboard, stat tile or data visualization in any medium (HTML/React artifact, SVG, matplotlib/plotly/d3/Recharts, PNG). Form heuristic, color formula + validator, mark specs, interaction rules, validated default palette.
Design guidance and page contract for Artifacts (title, libraries, theming tokens, dark mode, layout, size). Load before writing any artifact page.
When a diagram earns its place in an Artifact and how to draw legible inline-SVG diagrams that work in both themes.

Runtime capabilities for published Artifacts: live/connected data, shared state/db, viewer identity, ask-Claude, file storage, downloads, camera/mic/location. Load before passing `capabilities` or writing window.claude.* code.
Configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json: hooks for automated behaviours ('whenever X', 'before/after X'), permissions, env vars, hook troubleshooting.
Customize keyboard shortcuts / chord bindings in ~/.claude/keybindings.json.
Review the current diff or a PR/branch/path for correctness bugs at an effort level (low..max). --comment posts inline PR comments, --fix applies fixes, --max-findings N.
Review changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency and altitude cleanups, then apply fixes. Quality only — not a bug hunt.
Scan transcripts for common read-only Bash/MCP calls and add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json.
Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (/loop 5m /foo) or self-paced. Not for one-off tasks.

Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK: model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, migration. Trigger whenever Claude/Anthropic/LLM-shaped work is involved; never answer pricing/model questions from memory.
Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser, library); screenshot or confirm in the real app.
Make or debug a 'mod': a change to Claude's own interface/behaviour — side panel, band, status line, toast, slash command, or tool-call hook.
Initialize a CLAUDE.md for the current repository by analysing the codebase.
Security review of the pending changes on the current branch.
